services.name: Carpet Cleaning
services.summary: Hot water extraction steam cleaning and practical carpet care for homes, rentals, offices, and commercial spaces.
services.intro: Professional carpet cleaning by hot water extraction, using van-mounted industrial-grade equipment and practical methods suited to the carpet, soiling, and condition of the room.
overviewParagraphs: At Advanced Carpets & Restoration, we use a van-mounted carpet cleaning machine and industrial-grade equipment so we can provide high-quality work the first time.

Using a van-mounted system means we do not need your power or hot water. By choosing hot water extraction, you can be confident your carpets are visually clean and treated for bacteria, dust mites, and other contaminants.
Whether you need a one-time deep clean or regular maintenance, we help keep carpets in good condition across Cromwell, Alexandra, Wanaka, Clyde, Queenstown, and the greater Central Otago area.

sections.heading: Hot Water Extraction (Steam Cleaning)
paragraphs: Hot water extraction injects hot water at high pressure, helping loosen embedded dirt, oils, and debris from carpet fibres. The method is especially useful when paired with the right pre-treatment for the carpet and type of soiling.
bullets: Deep cleaning with hot water helps lift embedded soil from carpet fibres.
The heat can reduce common bacteria, mould spores, dust mites, and allergens.
Professional-grade temperature and suction help balance cleaning performance with drying time.
Dry times are usually between 4 and 8 hours, depending on carpet type, pile thickness, airflow, and how much soil needs to be removed.
High water temperature can help strip greasy soiling from carpets in pubs, restaurants, and other high-use spaces.

sections.heading: Common scenarios where steam cleaning helps
bullets: Allergies or asthma, where reducing dust mites and allergens is important.
Pet households, where odours and pet-related marks need targeted treatment.
High-traffic areas that look worn because embedded dirt has built up.
Routine maintenance that helps extend carpet life when combined with regular vacuuming.
Commercial carpets with grease, oils, or heavy foot traffic.

sections.heading: How often to clean carpet
paragraphs: How often you should clean carpet depends on usage, traffic, pets, and the environment. These are practical guidelines that can be tailored to the property.
bullets: Light to moderate traffic: deep clean every 12 to 18 months and vacuum weekly.
High-traffic areas or households with kids: deep clean every 12 months and vacuum 2 to 3 times per week.
Homes with pets: deep clean every 6 to 8 months and vacuum 3 to 4 times per week to manage hair and odours.
Allergy or asthma sufferers: deep clean every 6 to 8 months and vacuum weekly with a high-efficiency filter.

services.whyAdvanced: Advanced Carpets & Restoration uses van-mounted commercial equipment, suitable pre-treatment, and practical advice before and after the clean. The team matches the method to the carpet and the condition of the room instead of using a one-size-fits-all approach.

Strong sanitising effect that can reduce bacteria, mould spores, dust mites, and allergens

faqs.question: How long does carpet take to dry after hot water extraction?
faqs.answer: Dry times are usually between 4 and 8 hours, depending on carpet type, pile thickness, airflow, weather, and how much soil needs to be removed.

faqs.question: Do you need my power or hot water?
faqs.answer: No. The van-mounted carpet cleaning system means the team does not need to use your power or hot water.

faqs.question: How often should carpet be deep cleaned?
faqs.answer: Light to moderate traffic may suit every 12 to 18 months, while homes with pets, kids, allergies, or heavy traffic may benefit from a deep clean every 6 to 12 months.

services.name: Upholstery Cleaning
services.summary: Specialised upholstery cleaning for fabric furniture, mattresses, chairs, and other high-use upholstered surfaces.
services.intro: Professional upholstery cleaning to keep fabric surfaces looking fresh, clean, and comfortable across lounges, mattresses, chairs, and other furniture items.
overviewParagraphs: At Advanced Carpets & Restoration, we provide professional upholstery cleaning services to keep fabric surfaces looking fresh and clean.

Our skilled technicians use specialised upholstery tools designed to clean a wide variety of fabric materials, helping lounge suites, mattresses, chairs, and other furniture items feel thoroughly cleaned and revitalised.

sections.heading: Why get upholstery cleaned
bullets: Professional upholstery cleaning is recommended every 12 to 24 months to remove deep-seated dirt, allergens, and bacteria that regular vacuuming cannot remove.
Stains from spills such as wine or coffee can oxidise and bond permanently with fabric dyes if they are not treated with the correct professional chemistry.
When colour starts to look faded, steam cleaning can help colours look brighter again.
Regular cleaning removes dead skin cells and food crumbs that dust mites and other microscopic pests feed on.

sections.heading: Fabric and furniture care
paragraphs: Fabric type matters, so the technician checks the material and chooses a suitable method before cleaning. The aim is to refresh the item while respecting the construction, fibre, and current condition.

services.whyAdvanced: Advanced Carpets & Restoration uses upholstery-specific tools and practical fabric checks before cleaning. The team chooses a method that suits the material rather than treating all furniture the same way.

services.name: Solar Panel Cleaning
services.summary: Solar panel cleaning to remove dust, grime, pollen, bird droppings, and build-up that can reduce panel performance.
services.intro: Professional solar panel cleaning for homes and businesses across Central Otago and the Southern Lakes, helping maintain solar system performance with safe, non-abrasive cleaning.
overviewParagraphs: Advanced Carpets & Restoration provides professional solar panel cleaning services in the Central Otago and Southern Lakes area, helping homeowners and businesses maintain optimal solar system performance.

Over time, dust, pollen, bird droppings, and environmental debris can significantly reduce solar panel efficiency. In changing weather conditions, regular solar panel cleaning helps support energy output and long-term system performance.

Our solar panel cleaning service uses safe, non-abrasive methods that remove build-up without damaging panels or coatings. We service residential and commercial solar installations and tailor each clean to suit roof access and system layout.

sections.heading: When to book professional solar panel cleaning
paragraphs: Recommended cleaning is twice a year. One clean at the end of autumn helps maximise power input over the low-sun winter months, and a second clean at the end of spring removes pollen and dust to help keep efficiency as high as possible.
bullets: Dust, pollen, bird droppings, and grime can reduce panel performance.
Dirty panels can lose up to 30% efficiency depending on the situation.
Residential and commercial arrays can both benefit from regular cleaning.
Cleaning should be tailored to roof access, system layout, and panel condition.

services.whyAdvanced: Advanced Carpets & Restoration uses safe, non-abrasive solar panel cleaning methods and adjusts each clean to suit the roof access, system layout, and panel condition.
services.imageCaption: Solar panel cleaning to remove dust, pollen, bird droppings, and weather build-up.
services.resultsCopy: Use the comparison to review the visible build-up on solar panels before and after safe, non-abrasive cleaning.
benefits: Helps maintain panel efficiency
Useful after dry, dusty, or pollen-heavy periods
Suitable for residential and commercial solar arrays
Removes dust, pollen, bird droppings, grime, and environmental debris
useCases: Dust, grime, and bird dropping build-up

faqs.question: Why clean solar panels?
faqs.answer: Dust, pollen, bird droppings, and grime can reduce panel performance. Regular cleaning helps panels capture sunlight more effectively.

faqs.question: How often should solar panels be cleaned?
faqs.answer: Cleaning is commonly recommended twice a year: at the end of autumn before the low-sun winter months, and at the end of spring to remove pollen and dust.

faqs.question: Can dirty panels affect efficiency?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dirty panels can lose up to 30% efficiency depending on the situation.
